data.one_liner: Provides adaptive size extensions and widgets for responsive Flutter layouts.
data.what_it_does: Adds extension methods like .h, .w, .dp to calculate dimensions based on screen size. Supplies a FlutterSizer widget to expose orientation and screen type for conditional UI.
use_when: You need quick, percentage‑based sizing without writing custom MediaQuery code
You want to support both portrait/landscape and tablet/mobile layouts easily
avoid_when: You require fine‑grained layout control beyond simple percentages
You need a full theming or design system rather than just size helpers
strengths: Very simple API using extension methods
weaknesses: Limited to percentage‑based sizing, no breakpoint system
No built‑in support for complex responsive grids

alternatives.name: sizer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Similar extension‑based API with active maintenance

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides breakpoint‑based responsive design and theming

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers widget‑based responsive utilities with more layout options
